purpose: Evaluate Appeal end to end against real cases with a denial, appeal evidence, policy context, and an adjudicated outcome.

required_case_package.minimum: denial letter or structured equivalent with date, service, and explicit denial reason
policy or medical-necessity criteria version used for the decision
de-identified evidence actually available to the appeal reviewer
appeal submission, decision, dates, and disposition
review rationale, final outcome, and outcome date when available
explicit status or documented not_applicable value

required_release_evidence: written reuse permission or applicable data-use agreement
de-identification or redaction attestation from the data owner
privacy review decision and reviewer identity
artifact hashes without publishing raw case material
access, retention, and deletion controls for the local copy
not_satisfied_by: the Oregon IRO aggregate case-detail report alone
a third-party mirror without source reconciliation
Synthea or any other synthetic patient record

acceptance.unlock_condition: A data owner supplies the complete package and a human reviewer records provenance, reuse, privacy, schema, and access decisions.
